# Parsing Arguments with clap

`clap` (Command Line Argument Parser) is the de facto standard for argument parsing in the Rust ecosystem. Its procedural `derive` macros turn Rust structs into robust, auto-documenting command-line parsers with zero boilerplate.

## Adding clap with Derive

In `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive", "env"] }
```

## Basic CLI Definition

Define a struct representing your CLI arguments and derive `Parser`:

```rust
use clap::Parser;
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "minigrep")]
#[command(version = "1.0.0")]
#[command(about = "A blazing fast search tool", long_about = None)]
struct Cli {
    /// The search query pattern
    #[arg(short, long)]
    query: String,

    /// Target file path to search
    #[arg(short, long, value_name = "FILE")]
    path: PathBuf,

    /// Case-insensitive search
    #[arg(short = 'i', long)]
    ignore_case: bool,

    /// Number of matching context lines to display
    #[arg(short = 'C', long, default_value_t = 0)]
    context: usize,
}

fn main() {
    let cli = Cli::parse();

    println!("Searching for pattern '{}' in {:?}", cli.query, cli.path);
    if cli.ignore_case {
        println!("Case-insensitive search enabled");
    }
}
```

Running `minigrep --help` generates an idiomatic Unix-compliant help screen complete with flags, options, version strings, and usage instructions automatically.

## Subcommands with Enums

Real-world developer tools (like `git`, `docker`, or `cargo`) organize features into subcommands. In `clap`, subcommands are modeled as Rust enums:

```rust
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "gitclone", about = "Minimal VCS clone")]
struct App {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Commands {
    /// Initialize a new repository
    Init {
        #[arg(default_value = ".")]
        path: PathBuf,
    },
    /// Clone an existing remote repository
    Clone {
        /// Remote repository URL
        url: String,
        /// Local destination directory
        dest: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Commit staged changes
    Commit {
        #[arg(short, long)]
        message: String,
    },
}

fn main() {
    let app = App::parse();

    match app.command {
        Commands::Init { path } => println!("Initialized repository at {:?}", path),
        Commands::Clone { url, dest } => println!("Cloning {} into {:?}", url, dest),
        Commands::Commit { message } => println!("Committed: {}", message),
    }
}
```
